### Added

- run each repository's declared pool maintenance and report what it freed ([#911](https://github.com/nickderobertis/onepipeline/pull/911))

### Fixed

- *(deps)* adopt the plan store that copies a private source's documents ([#943](https://github.com/nickderobertis/onepipeline/pull/943))

### Linked engines

The sibling engines this release actually links, resolved from its own `Cargo.lock`:

| Engine | Linked | Requirement | Newest the requirement permits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `oneagentgraph` | 0.5.7 | `0.5.6` | 0.5.7 |
| `onevcs` | 0.52.0 | `0.52.0` | 0.52.0 |
| `onevcs-testing` | 0.19.4 | `0.19.4` | 0.19.4 |

| `onetaskgraph-core` | 0.7.1 | `=0.7.1` | 0.7.1 |

> [!NOTE]
> A newer release of an engine below exists that this build's own requirements
> **hold back**: it requires a sibling engine outside the window `Cargo.toml` states,
> so no `cargo update` takes it without a second copy of that sibling, and only a
> requirement move lifts it:
>
> - `oneagentgraph` links 0.5.7, the newest its requirement permits that this manifest admits; 0.5.13 is held back by `oneharness-core = "0.24.1"` (0.5.13 requires oneharness-core ^0.28.1).
> - `onejudge` links 0.19.0, the newest its requirement permits that this manifest admits; 0.19.5 is held back by `oneharness-core = "0.24.1"` (0.19.5 requires oneharness-core ^0.28.1).

Every linked engine is the newest its own requirement permits among the releases this manifest admits.
